command.name: security key-manager external aws update-config
command.description: This command allows the user to update the configuration file used by the Amazon Web Service Key Management Service (AWSKMS) configured for the given Vserver. The configuration is initialized by running the security key-manager external aws enable command. This command will fail if AWSKMS has not been enabled for the Vserver.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver for which the AWSKMS configuration will be updated.

parameter.name: port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the port of the deployed AWSKMS.

parameter.name: default-domain
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the default domain of the deployed AWSKMS.

parameter.name: service
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the type of service of the deployed AWSKMS.

parameter.name: encryption-context
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the encryption context to satisfy AWS grant constraint if it is configured. The parameter should be in JSON format.

example.p: The following example updates the AWSKMS configuration for Vserver v1 with a new port number 2333, a new default domain "amazonaws.com", a new service "test_KMS" and an encryption context of "{"team": "NVEsecurity"}".
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager external aws update-config -vserver v1 -port 2333 -default-domain amazonaws.com -service test_KMS -encryption-context {"team": "NVEsecurity"}
